audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect confirmed: the chart hands LeBlanc 5 of 7 stages while Ahri wins the matchup 52.79%. On top of that the full layer reads "Skill" on all seven rows while the content layer reads LeBlanc x5 then Ahri x2 — two different answers to the same question.
audit.why: LeBlanc's real edge is levels 1-3, before Charm and before Spirit Rush, when a Sigil detonation off a Distortion blink-in is a kill. Levels 4-5 are genuinely contested, and from level 6 Spirit Rush lets Ahri leave the Ethereal Chains shackle before its 1.5-second root, which is the mechanic her whole combo depends on.
audit.corrected: LeBlanc / LeBlanc / LeBlanc / Skill / Ahri / Ahri / Ahri across both layers, proposed as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] (Lvl 6) is written as a LeBlanc spike and credits Mirror Image with giving her "a full burst-and-escape combo with her ultimate", which mixes up her passive with Mimic.
audit.why: Mirror Image is a below-40%-health passive: 1 second of invisibility and a clone that deals no damage. Mimic is the ultimate, 45/35/25s, and it recasts a basic spell. Level 6 is Ahri's spike here, not LeBlanc's.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[1].text as the Spirit Rush answer to the shackle.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction is missing everywhere, and the content early paragraph names "Shatter Orb" as part of LeBlanc's combo. That ability does not exist in her kit.
audit.why: Riot text, Ethereal Chains: "launches a chain that shackles the first enemy hit. If the target remains shackled for 1.5 seconds, LeBlanc roots them and deals additional damage." Leaving the 925 range inside that 1.5 seconds prevents the root — Spirit Rush's three dashes are exactly that. Distortion also has a hard 4-second return window on a 15s-to-10s cooldown: blink in and hold it too long and she is stranded.
audit.corrected: Both facts written into cooldowns, dos, loading, report[5] and the content mid/early paragraphs; "Shatter Orb" removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown numbers on the page — every reference was the vague "fifteen-second invitation".
audit.why: Distortion 15/13.75/12.5/11.25/10 with a 4s return; Ethereal Chains 14/13.25/12.5/11.75/11; Sigil of Malice 6s with a 3.5s mark; Mimic 45/35/25.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mirror Image never explained despite being the reason a Charm gets wasted.
audit.why: Riot text: below 40% health she turns invisible for 1 second and leaves a clone that deals no damage for up to 8 seconds.
audit.corrected: Added to dontsFull[2].d as a do-not-spend-Charm cue.
